digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Tracker re-cloning without carrying `.env-id` silently regenerates a new environment identity UUID, rendering all prior op-cert attestations unverifiable and blocking the claim gate with `verdict: foreign_key`
The `.env-id` ensure unit and `_gen_local_files` mint a fresh UUID whenever `.env-id` is absent, without checking whether the store already contains events stamped by a different environment

Minting a new `.env-id` over a populated store must emit a loud stderr warning naming the prior environment ID(s), attestation consequence, git-ignored carry-over files, and the override flag, but still complete the mint to support multi-clone workflows
`rebar fsck` must emit a counted `ENV_ID_MISMATCH` check scoped by author, firing when the current environment's own authors also wrote events under a different environment ID
The override mechanism is `REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1` (environment variable), which acknowledges the situation and quietens the warning to a one-line note
Store-wide re-identification is never detectable at re-clone time; it only surfaces hours later when a gate attempts to verify a ticket with an attestation from the orphaned environment
